knownCorpora.description: 25 owner-supplied portrait H.264/AAC programming videos already used for development evaluation.

rules: Missing, duplicate, malformed, or failed evidence blocks the broad-release evidence set.
A development corpus can exercise matching media slots but can never satisfy the independent holdout gate.
Fixture evidence verifies this evaluator only and can never certify a release.
Completing every gate still requires an explicit owner release decision; this manifest never changes releaseDefault.

gates.description: A rights-cleared, version-locked corpus not used to tune the implementation.
Gold-transcript ASR accuracy and subtitle timing thresholds are measured and pass.
Human-labelled scene-boundary precision and recall are measured and pass.
An audio-only source is exercised end-to-end.
A still-image source is exercised end-to-end.
Ambiguous or multi-track media is exercised with explicit stream selection.
A source at least two hours long is exercised end-to-end.
Media with a non-zero stream start offset is exercised end-to-end.
Corrupt or incomplete media fails explicitly without committing a false Result.
The 100-file/10-hour query and memory benchmark is measured and passes.
A human watched the exact representative Result and recorded an outcome.
A human listened to the exact representative Result and recorded an outcome.
A representative exact Result is checked against its approved delivery promise without silent downgrade.
